points.text: SC on crackers: **Art. 25(1)** is a **qualified** right, limited by public order, morality and health, read with **Art. 21**. **Art. 48A** directs the State to protect the environment; **Art. 51A(g)** makes it a **Fundamental Duty**.
Right to protest: **Art. 19(1)(a) and (b)**, with reasonable restrictions under **19(2) and (3)**.
**Six** States have a Legislative Council — **Maharashtra, U.P., Bihar, A.P., Telangana, Karnataka** (**Art. 168**).
**Art. 169**: Parliament creates or abolishes a Council by ordinary law after the Assembly passes a **two-thirds** resolution.
**Art. 171**: a Council is at most **one-third** of the Assembly and at least **40**; **1/3** by local bodies, **1/12** graduates, **1/12** teachers, **1/3** MLAs, **1/6** nominated.
**Art. 172**: a Council is **never dissolved**; members serve **6 years**, one-third retiring every 2 years.
Weak powers: no joint sitting; delay of up to **four months** (**Art. 197**); on a Money Bill it can **only make recommendations within 14 days** (**Art. 198**).
The **Government of India Act, 1935** gave six provinces bicameral legislatures: Madras, Bombay, Bengal, United Provinces, Bihar, Assam.
**Tamil Nadu** abolished its Council in **1986** under CM **M.G. Ramachandran**; **Andhra Pradesh** abolished its in 1985 (NTR) and revived it in **2007**.
The **Second ARC (2007)** wanted Councils turned into '**councils of local governments**'.
Three AAP leaders joined the BJP in Punjab; two Bihar MLCs' switch drew **Tenth Schedule** notices — **para 2(2)** disqualifies an independent who joins a party.
JD(U) expelled Mokama MLA **Anant Singh** and his wife for six years; the SC told him to surrender by **1 Dec** in a murder case.

**BNSS** replaced the **Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973** on **1 July 2024**, with **BNS** for the IPC and **BSA** for the Evidence Act; a Jantar Mantar protester was held under **BNSS 126 and 170**.
The SC quashed the **Rajasthan SEC**'s ban on civil-society voter awareness; **Section 163 BNSS** (old **CrPC 144**) needs a real threat to peace.
**State Election Commissions** are constitutional bodies under **Art. 243K** (panchayats) and **Art. 243ZA** (municipalities).
Amit Shah claimed the SIR removed about **13 crore** names (4.25 crore double entries, 3 crore dead, 1 crore duplicates); these are his claims.
The ECI will let judges **e-sign** orders on ECINet for West Bengal's **19 appellate tribunals**; **38 lakh** of 60 lakh cases are pending.
**VB-G RAM G** = **Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)**, which replaced **MGNREGA** in 2026 under the **VB-G RAM G Act, 2025**.
New grievance rules: complaints logged the same or next day, inquiry in **7 days**, resolution in **15**; an FIR for financial irregularity was dropped from the draft.
Census Phase 2 starts **1 Dec 2026** in U.P., Uttarakhand, Goa and Punjab; **40 questions** (13 new), India's first **digital** census with **34 lakh** enumerators.
RGI and Census Commissioner: **Mritunjay Kumar Narayan**; training framework **PRAMAN**. Census is a **Union List** subject (**Entry 69**) under the **Census Act, 1948**.
First **caste enumeration** since Independence (**Q.10C**): SC/ST pick from a list, others type their caste; no separate OBC column; **Aadhaar optional**.
**FRROs** will cover every State capital by 2027 (now **20**), under the **Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025**, which merged four laws.
Kerala moved **35 IAS officers**; **K.R. Jyothilal** became ACS (Home and Vigilance).
FM **Nirmala Sitharaman**: public **capex** continues till private investment revives, but 'fiscal prudence is non-negotiable'.
Tamil Nadu's committed spending is about **two-thirds** of revenue receipts; capex is under **1.5% of GSDP**.
**RBI KYC** update camps run **21 October to 31 December 2026**; a self-declaration is enough if nothing changed.
Congress sought a **JPC** on the **IDBI Bank** sale to Canada's **Fairfax**.
**Sensex 75,682.78**, **Nifty 23,440** (both +1.7%); **Reliance Industries** jumped 11.6%.
**HSBC India Manufacturing PMI**: **54.7** in October; above **50** means expansion.
**Tata Sons** gave **N. Chandrasekaran** a third term; **Darius Khambata** objected to Tata Trusts chair **Noel Tata**.
**Petronet LNG** Q2 profit up 53.2% to ₹1,235 crore; **Vultr** opened a **20-MW AI supercluster** in Chennai; **IndiGo** lost about ₹1,879 crore.
SC upheld about **$99 million** of foreign arbitral awards to **Vedanta** over the **Ravva** oilfield (1994 contract, Kuala Lumpur seat, UNCITRAL rules).
New airfare rules under the **Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024** let the Centre direct fares in 'extraordinary situations'; **no fare caps**. Airlines must file tariffs with the **DGCA**.
PM Modi opened the **Bharat Renewable Energy Summit** at **Bharat Mandapam**: about **$220 billion** of investment potential by 2030.
Russia's **LNG** exports rose **13.4%** to 28 million tonnes, helped by **Arctic LNG 2**; natural **rubber** hit a record **₹300/kg**.
**GRAP Stage 2** was invoked at **AQI 324**; GRAP has **four stages** and is run by the **CAQM**.
Outside **below-BS-VI** vehicles are barred till **31 Jan**: on day two, **1,228 of 8,263** were turned back.
SC allowed **green crackers** in Delhi-NCR only on **7 and 8 November**, **6-7 a.m. and 8-10 p.m.** (Justices **Sundresh** and **Varale**); none within **300 m** of hospitals and schools.
Only **CSIR-NEERI/PESO**-certified makers may produce (2-6 Nov); boxes need **QR codes**; no **ladis**; sales 4-6 Nov. The SC said the State had 'utterly failed' since 2015.
Abroad: **Singapore** bans private crackers; the UK and Ireland restrict sales; **Germany and Sweden** need permits.
**Stockholm Declaration (1972)** linked well-being to the environment; the **Rio Declaration (1992)** gave the **precautionary** and **polluter-pays** principles.
The **Siang Upper** project (**11.2 GW**, **Arunachal Pradesh**) answers China's **60 GW** dam on the **Yarlung Tsangpo**; a 36-hour bandh and **Adi** protests continue.
**Kuno**: a task force found cheetah cub **KNG22** was shot by recreational hunters.
Indonesia's fires burned **1.9 million hectares** (Jan-Sep), worsened by **El Nino** and the **Indian Ocean Dipole**; Singapore used its **Transboundary Haze Pollution Act**.
Cyclone **Murasu** made landfall in **Andhra Pradesh**, between **Ongole and Nellore** at up to **120 km/h**; **14 NDRF teams** deployed.
**Meghalaya** got **38.3 mm** of rain in October against a normal of 255 mm — an **85% deficit**.
Places: the **Ravva** oilfield is in the **Krishna-Godavari** basin, A.P.; **Jhunjhunu** (Rajasthan) saw eight electrocuted.
Iran can reopen the **Strait of Hormuz** 'in two days' on its terms; FM **Abbas Araghchi**, spokesman **Esmaeil Baqaei**. Hormuz has been shut since **February 2026**.
Yemen's **Houthis** claimed a drone strike on Saudi Arabia's **Dammam** airport.
**Justice S. Muralidhar**, chairing the UN inquiry on Palestine, cited genocidal acts in Gaza and the biggest West Bank displacement since 1967.
**Knesset**: **120** seats, **61** for a majority, **3.25%** threshold; **Likud** won **27**, its lowest in 13 years. The President gives **28 days (+14)** to form a government.
US midterms on **3 Nov**: tariffs and the Iran war dominate; **Kansas** has not elected a Democratic senator since **1932**.
Russia resumed strikes on **Kherson** after the **Oleshky** ceasefire brokered by **Melania Trump** collapsed.
NSA **Ajit Doval** met Vietnam's Defence Minister **Phan Van Giang** in Hanoi; the tie is an **Enhanced Comprehensive Strategic Partnership**.
China's **60 GW Yarlung Tsangpo** dam worries India; the two have **no water treaty**, only emergency flood data.
UK: care workers who arrived before **May 2025** can get settlement after **5 years** (not 15) on **£25,000+**; Home Secretary **Shabana Mahmood**.
The **UNGA** again voted against the **US embargo on Cuba**; India voted in favour. Venezuela's army hit a **Colombian ELN** camp in Apure.
**₹53,866.50 crore** for **8 Next Generation Corvettes**: **GRSE** 5 and **Goa Shipyard** 3 — the first Navy-designed warships built by defence PSUs.
Delhi Police protest: over 100 personnel opposed the transfers of **ACP Manasvi Vashistha** and an SHO; Commissioner **Anurag Kumar**.
MP Inspector **Dilip Puri** was run over by a liquor-smuggling truck; **ICGS C-448** rescued a fisherman off Mangaluru.
ED searched ex-Punjab minister **Sunder Sham Arora**; ex-T.N. minister **Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi** is in CCB custody over ₹400 crore of alleged bribes.
**DPDP Act 2023**: Rules notified **Nov 2025**, fully in force **May 2027**; privacy became a fundamental right in **2017**. Gaps: no sensitive-data category, silence on AI training.
**UCLA**'s optical-electronic deepfake detector is **99.86%** accurate on fakes and uses **7x less energy**; people spot deepfakes only about **50%** of the time.
**Kavli Prize** (astrophysics) to **Vasily Belokurov, Amina Helmi and Rodrigo Ibata** for the Milky Way's past galaxy **mergers** — Sagittarius, **Gaia-Enceladus**, Kraken-Heracles.
**Sputnik 2** (3 Nov 1957) carried **Laika**, the first animal in orbit; **Mariner 10** (3 Nov 1973) was the first probe to **Mercury**.
*PNAS*: cigarette smoke silences the **Zbp1** gene in lung organoids; a **Kras** mutation then drives adenocarcinoma. Many Indian lung-cancer patients never smoked.
3 Nov in science: **Alzheimer** presented his patient and the **SOS** signal was adopted (both 1906); the first **UNIX** manual appeared in 1971.
Hackers pushed supermarket **freezers to 50°C** in Sweden and other European countries.

SC on **bonded labour**: aid within **7 days**, complaints verified in **24 hours**; a 'continuing constitutional obligation'. Law: **Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976**; **Art. 23** bans forced labour.
**POCSO**: a Kasaragod paediatrician got **47 years** (20 concurrent) for assaulting a 15-year-old patient.
**India Hate Lab** recorded **60 attacks on Christians** in West Bengal between 13 May and 20 Sept.
Fire at the **HPCL Visakh Refinery**, Visakhapatnam; no casualties.
**National Unity Day** (since **2014**) is **31 Oct**; the **Statue of Unity** is **182 m**, opened in **2018**.
India: CJI **Surya Kant**; SG **Tushar Mehta**; CEC **Gyanesh Kumar**; RGI **Mritunjay Kumar Narayan**; NSA **Ajit Doval**; FM **Nirmala Sitharaman**.
World: Israel **Netanyahu**; Iran FM **Araghchi**; UK Home Secretary **Shabana Mahmood**; Indonesia **Prabowo Subianto**; Vietnam **Phan Van Giang**.
**Kimi Antonelli** (Mercedes) became the **youngest F1 champion** at **20 years 68 days**, past **Sebastian Vettel** (23y 134d); first Italian champion since **Alberto Ascari (1953)**.
**Glenn Maxwell** retired from internationals: **7 Tests, 149 ODIs, 130 T20Is**.
**Tilak Varma** will captain India A in the **ACC Men's Rising Stars Asia Cup**; IPL retention closes **17 Nov**, mini auction in **Goa on 16 Dec**.
Ranji: Services captain **Rajat Paliwal** made 111*; **Jammu & Kashmir** are the defending champions.
Hockey: India beat **Korea 8-0**; the Asian Champions Trophy knockouts move to **Mohali**.
**Archery Premier League**: a **15-second** shot clock (20 s at World Cups); USA's **Casey Kaufhold** plays for Chero Archers.
The **Indian Golf Premier League**'s 10th leg is in **Visakhapatnam**; the WTA **Chennai Open**'s first day was washed out.
